description: Figure 2, captioned "Performance with different chunking sizes," is a line plot that illustrates how the performance of a retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) system varies as the chunking size, denoted as N, increases from 200 to 1500 tokens. The x-axis represents the chunking size (N) in tokens, ranging from 200 to 1500, with tick marks at regular intervals. The y-axis represents the performance score, though its specific label and unit are not provided in the visible text. The plot contains multiple lines, each corresponding to a different retrieval source or method, distinguished by color and marker style. Each line shows a trend in performance as N increases, with some lines exhibiting a peak or plateau around 800 tokens, while others show a steady increase or decline. The text below the figure notes that most sources are best represented by the first 800 tokens, except for SO posts, and that reranking within the 200–800 token range degrades results, while pre-retrieval achieves the highest scores.
